relevance_note: FMZ-PET study of 7 patients with SSADH deficiency with per-patient clinical and MRI data in Table 1 ('Clinical and imagingdata of affected subjects').
method_note: Table 1 (patients as rows, column 'Patient no.' with bare numbers 1-7) was transcribed by a short Python script and checked against the table by hand. Labels: the text itself uses 'patient 1' (Figure 1 legend) and 'Patients 3 and 4' (Table 1 footnote), so rule 1 was applied uniformly as 'Patient <n>' for all seven (alternative would be 'Table 1 #<n>'). Abbreviations in the neurologic examination and seizure columns were expanded with the Table 1 legend, quoted as a second span. Absence of an abbreviation from a patient's list was not taken as exclusion. Seizures 'None' was taken as an explicit statement of no seizures (excluded). 'Age, y' was taken as age at time of study (last evaluation). Sex only stated for patients 3 and 4 (sisters); group sex count (4 male) not assigned. No ALDH5A1 variant is printed or tied to any individual; inclusion required enzyme deficiency and/or a pathogenic mutation, so no variant rows were created. EEG: 'Two affected subjects ... normal for age. Five had diffuse slowing' is not attributed to named patients, so the EEG checklist item is not reported for all. T2 hyperintensity: the five patients with 'GP, sub, den: bilateral symmetric homogeneous signal abnormalities' in Table 1 (1, 3, 4, 6, 7) were matched to the text 'Five patients ... hyperintensity on T2-weighted sequences' by identical wording, not by position. Patient 2 identified with the text's 'oldest (27 years old) patient' (Table 1 age 27, GP volume loss) and patient 5 with 'One patient had marked ventriculomegaly' (Table 1 ventriculomegaly, GP L > R); their GP signal abnormality was not described as T2 hyperintensity, so that checklist item is not reported. 'No cortical abnormalities on MRI' (group statement on the patients) recorded as an excluded feature but not used to exclude the broader 'cerebral or cerebellar atrophy'. 'All patients had hyporeflexia and motor dyspraxia' used as a named-group statement; motor dyspraxia mapped to 'gross or fine motor deficits' (judgement). Out of scope / no rows: 10 unaffected parents and 8 healthy controls (parents described only as a group and not linked to specific patients; Figure 2 shows an unidentified subject's parent). cohort_size_as_stated left null: the paper gives group sizes (7 patients, 10 parents, 8 controls) but no stated total. Dexmedetomidine sedation (5 of 7) not assigned to individuals. No contradictions found.
